changelog:
# Novel Tracker DB v1.0.9

A focused update improving **navigation, version management, item handling, and Android reliability**.

## ✨ What's New

- Fixed Home page scroll-position restoration when returning from a novel.
- Fixed issues with the Novel Design page.
- Added a redesigned **Novel Version Selector** in the previous search location.
- Version names can now be renamed **globally across all novels** using that version.
- Removed individual novel version creation to keep version management consistent.
- Latest novel version/data is now shown first by default.
- Improved tag priority so newer version metadata overrides outdated tags.
- Improved item text readability while preserving Title and Synopsis styling.
- Added **Delete Item** with confirmation and **Duplicate Item** through the existing item menu.
- Improved Android back button, keyboard, safe-area, file selection, lifecycle, screen restoration, and offline persistence.
- Preserved the existing minimalist design and local data structure.

### 📱 Android

Improved the overall Android experience so the app behaves more reliably as an offline application rather than simply a web page running inside Android.
